Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from the first Warm Up game! A big win for Afghanistan but another loss for Pakistan. They have a lot to think about. However, there are two mouth-watering clashes on Saturday with Australia taking on England in Southampton and India taking on New Zealand at The Oval. Both the games begin at 1030 local (0930 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

Afghanistan skipper, Gulbadin Naib, says it is a great victory for their team and their supporters. Reckons the wicket was flat and it looked like a 300-plus wicket. Credits the bowlers for how they bowled and he is pleased they restricted them to 260. States Pakistan is one of the best sides in the world and they can't take it easy, they have to give it their all. Ends by thanking the fans for their support.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfaraz Khan, says they did not have enough runs on the board. Mentions they did not bowl well too in the first 10 overs. Further adds it is very tough if they are losing games but then need to back themselves and he hopes they will do well very soon. States the mood in the dressing room is very fine, the batters are doing well but it is their bowling which they have to work on. Says Babar Azam is the best batsman in his team and Wahab Riaz was top notch today.

Hashmatullah Shahidi who is up for an interview says he feels amazing after this win against Pakistan. Mentions he wanted to stay there till the end and finish the game. Mentions there were wickets falling but he stayed calm and Nabi supported him and he finished the game. States the Pakistan pace attack is very good and he is pleased he did well. States this game was important for them and it is a good win for Afghanistan. Thanks the crowd for the support they gave them.

Earlier in the day, Pakistan elected to bat and it was Babar Azam's ton which powered them to 262. They could have got a lot more but Afghanistan bowled really well in the second half of the first innings and in the end, that proved to be the differential factor.

The Pakistan bowling was once again not at its best. The pacers early on took a real pounding, especially Shaheen Afridi. Shadab Khan did have a wicket to his name but was expensive. Although Imad Wasim and Wahab Riaz were the positives for Pakistan. The former was extremely accurate and the latter was exciting to watch. Had it not been for the two, Afghanistan would have had a stroll in the park.

It was always going to be a tricky chase and it turned out to be that way. Yes, Afghanistan got off to a flier, courtesy their openers but Shahzad then had to retire hurt and Zazai fell a run short of a half ton. The brakes were then applied but the good thing for Afghanistan was, they did not lose wickets. They stitched handy stands and Shahidi was the mainstay. He anchored the innings and the rest played around him. His 50-plus run stand with Nabi was the one which probably took Afghanistan to the brink of victory. However, there was drama in the end where they lost a few wickets quickly, Shahidi and Rashid Khan held their nerves and ensured they got home.
What a game that was in the end! What a win for Afghanistan. Yes, it is just a warm-up match, but this will be a morale booster for the minnows heading into just their 2nd World Cup.
There it is! Shahidi hits the winning runs for Afghanistan. A short ball outside off, he cuts it down to third man for a single. AFGHANISTAN WIN BY 3 WICKETS!

A run off the leading edge! SCORES LEVEL NOW! Afghanistan can't lose, they have three balls to win. Very full again on middle, Rashid looks to flick but the ball tails away. It goes off the leading edge down to third man for one.
In the air... safe! Two taken! Pressure released. 2 needed in 4. Misses the yorker by just. Rashid lofts it over mid off and takes a brace.
A dot to begin first up! A yorker outside off, Rashid fails to jam it out. 4 from 5.
Another single! 4 needed in 6 now. Full and on middle, this is driven back towards the bowler who dives to his right and makes a half stop. It rolls towards mid on for a run.
Good batting! Takes a single through square leg. 5 needed in 7.

FOUR! That is probably the shot which seals the deal for Afghanistan. Poor delivery by Khan. He fires it down the leg side, easy pickings for Shahidi, he flicks it through backward square leg. The fielder in the deep does put in a dive but fails to stop it.
Short ball and Shadab gets away with it. It is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run. 10 needed in 9 now.
A single now! This is fired outside off, Shahidi looks to cut but gets a bottom edge. It goes between the legs of the keeper for a single.
Starts off with a short one on middle, Shahidi goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Jaffa! A dot! 14 needed in 12 now. Goes around the wicket to the right hander. It begins from off and then tails away. It is a yorker. Rashid looks to jam it out but misses.
Rashid Khan comes in.

OUT! No inside edge and it is umpire's call! Two in the over for Riaz and he has brought Pakistan back into the contest. Another one of those inswinging yorkers. Zadran looks to work it on the leg side but misses. Gets his on the pads. An appeal and the umpire raises the finger. The batsman reviews but replays show that the on-field call is the right one. He has to walk back but Afghanistan do not lose the review. 14 more needed 13. Game on!
Zadran has been given out LBW! He has reviewed. Looks out if there is no inside edge.
On the fuller side, the batter strokes it through cover point for one.
Full and way outside off, Zadran looks to put bat on ball but it goes off the inner half towards the leg side for a single.
Najibullah Zadran is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Pakistan are still in this! 16 from 16 now. What a corker of a yorker this is. On middle and it tails away. Naib looks to jam it out but plays down the wrong line. Knocks out the off pole. Pakistan would love 4 more deliveries like this.
A yorker from around the wicket, the line is outside off though. Naib looks to jam it out but misses. 16 needed in 17.
Swing and a miss! Shahidi wants to end it as soon as possible. He shuffles right across and Hasnain bowls it short. Shahidi swings but misses.
On the shorter side outside off, it is cut through point for another single.
Slower one on middle, this is eased down to long on for a single.
Is of the mark straightaway as he works it through mid-wicket.
Gulbadin Naib is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! There goes Nabi, however, one feels, it is a little too late. Slower one and outside off, Nabi goes after it away from his body but only gets an outside edge to the keeper who takes it. 19 needed in 22.
Runs needed now below 20! Short and on the body, Shahidi looks to pull but it hits the glove and rolls towards fine leg for one.
Short and outside off, Nabi looks to upper cut but misses.
WIDE! Down the leg side, it has been wided.
FOUR! Lovely shot! 21 needed now in 25. Length and outside off, Nabi strokes it through covers, it is away from the sweeper and a boundary results.
Another bouncer! Nabi evades it nicely!
Another yorker and this one is on off, it is hit to mid off.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed down to long on for a single.
A low full toss outside off, it is guided through point for one.
Wahab Riaz is back!
Another short one and HS ducks under it once again. This time it is not a wide.
Short and on the body of the batsman, Shahidi ducks under it and it has been wided. The bowler and the keeper are not happy.
On the shorter side, Nabi hops and slaps it through covers for one.
A little too straight again, Shahidi nicely works it around the corner and takes one.
Full and on the pads, this is clipped towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller on off, Shahidi hits it through covers for one.
Length and on off, Nabi guides it through point for a run.

FOUR! This over has probably released all the pressure that was built in the last. 11 from it. 33 more needed in 35. Shahidi goes down on one knee and plays the sweep, gets it away from square leg and the ball races away to the fence. The 50 run stand also comes up between both these batsmen.

Is that a drop catch? Well, Azam is in pain here. That was hit very hard but if it was a chance, it should have been taken. Replays though shows it was a chance. Has Azam just dropped the match here. Shahidi looks to play the slog sweep but due to the ball being very full. He fails to get under it. Hits it flat towards mid-wicket where Azam can't hang on.
Singles will do it for them! Nabi plants his front foot across and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Another single as Shahidi works it through square leg.
Smart batting! Follows the boundary up with a single through mid-wicket.
FOUR! Smashed! A little too full on off, Nabi swings through the line and it races to the cover fence.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket. Two dots to end, the runs needed is now more than the balls to be bowled.
Very full and outside off, Shahidi strokes it to covers.
Slower through the air on off, Nabi is a touch early in the shot but still manages to hit it through cover-point for another single.
On the stumps, kept out.
This is worked with the angle through mid-wicket for one.
This is eased through covers for a single.
This time flicks it wide of mid-wicket and keeps the strike with one.
On the pads, HS flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Fifty for Shahidi! He has been very good in this game. On the pads, Shahidi flicks it fine down the leg side for a boundary.

On off, tapped back to the bowler by Shahidi.

Tossed up on off, Nabi milks it to long off for a run. He will keep the strike.

Tossed up on middle, Nabi flicks it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
Short on the body, Nabi looks to make room and hit but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Shorter on off, HS punches it to covers and takes one.

It does not cost much. Just a single. He bowls it full away from Nabi. He cannot do much but just squeeze it to sweeper cover for a run.

Pitched outside off, defended to covers.

Flatter on the stumps, pushed to mid off.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.

WIDE! Down the leg side, HS looks to pull but misses.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

On the pads, it is worked down to fine leg for a single.
Good length on off, it is guided to point.

OHHH! BEATEN! Fuller in length and outside off, Sahidi looks to cut but connects with thin air. Luckily for Shahidi the ball misses the outside edge.
FOUR! Excellent placement! Goes short again and this time there is width on offer. Shahidi uses the pace and guides it to the left of third man for a boundary.
BEATEN! Short and outside off, Shahidi looks to cut but misses.
Short ball on the leg, it does not bounce much, Shahidi ducks under it.
FOUR! On a fuller length outside off, Shahidi leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary. Afghanistan looking in command here. No need to run for these.
Back of a length on off, it is kept out.
Shortish and outside off, it is slapped through covers for one.

This time it is slapped to the left of the fielder at cover for a single.
Slashed hard! Short and outside off, it is cut through point for a couple.

Another one which is driven to mid off.

Shinwari off the mark staightaway. A back of a length on leg, Shinwari flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Samiullah Shinwari comes in.

OUT! Shah loses his focus. A short delivery on leg, Shah tries to pull it towards fine leg but gets a little glove and the ball settles in the hands of skipper Sarfaraz. Much-needed wicket for Pakistan. The bowling change foes the trick. Shah departs after getting off to a start.

Goes back to bowling length and on off, it is defended.
Fullish and on the pads, Shahzad works it to mid-wicket.
On the shorter side and this is closer to the off pole, Shahzad stands tall and keeps it out.
Shahzad is in some discomfort here. The physio is out to have a look at his leg. Seems to be cramps.
FOUR! Again! Poor bowling this. He bangs it short and wide outside off, Shahzad once again cuts it through point. No stopping once it beats the fielders in the ring.
FOUR! Dealing in boundaries are Afghanistan! A little width on offer outside off and the batsman pounces on it. MS cuts it through point and bags a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Mohammad guides it to point.
Bends his back on this one and bowls it short but it is above the batsman's head. Wided.
Afridi may have missed his run up there! He bails out at the very end.
Another slower one on middle, Zazai works it to short fine leg.
Another slower one and Zazai strokes it nicely to covers.
Fullish and outside off, Zazai strokes it but finds covers.
Slower one on off, Shahzad waits for it and then guides it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length on off, it is defended onto the ground.
Fuller on off, Shahzad lunges and keeps it out.
FOUR! Wide outside off, Zazai smashes it through covers for the boundary. 21 runs from the over. Zazai having the upper hand against the bowler. He waves him to go back.
FOUR! Take that says Zazai. Short delivery by Shaheeh. Zazai pulls this towards the square leg region for another boundary. And that is how a batsman replies.

Wide! Shaheen bowls a bouncer which goes over the batsman's head. The umpire signals wide. A few words exchanged between the Zazai and Afridi. But Zazai is not interested as he signals Afridi to go to his bowling mark.
A dot ball against the run of play. And that's how a bowler replies. Bowls a bouncer on middle which goes past batsman's helmet.
FOUR! Three fours in a row. This is brilliant striking. Full on middle and leg, Zazai makes some room and smashes it past mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Crushed! Full on off, Zarzai drags it from off to mid-wicket for a four.
FOUR! Shaheen stays down the leg side. Zazai flicks it towards the square leg region for a boundary. That deserved to be hit.
Back of a length on off, it is guided to point. Excellent over for Afghanistan.

FOUR! Nicely played! Just used the pace of the bowler. Length and angling away from off. Shahzad opens the face and gets it past point. The  third man fielder runs to his right and dives but fails to stop it.
Fuller and on off, the batter looks to drive but it goes off the inner half to mid off.
FOUR! Poor ball and put away! Down the leg side, the batter flicks it fine to the fine leg fence.
On the shorter side and on the body, MS looks to pull but misses to get hit on the body.
This is angled into the batsman, he flicks it through square leg for a run.
Slightly fuller and outside off, MS mistimes it to covers.
FOUR! First of the innings! Full and on middle, Shahzad flicks it against the angle and through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Goes wide outside off again, looking to draw a loose stroke from Shahzad. He lets it be.
Another one just outside off, left alone.
Back of a length on off, it is kept out.
Shortish and outside off, Shahzad throws his bat at it but chops it to point.
Shaheen Afridi to bowl from the other end!
On the fuller side again, no swing on offer, Zazai pushes it to mid off. End of a good over by Amir.
Good length and around off, Zazai lunges and keeps it out.
Afghanistan are off the mark! Shahzad works it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
This one is angled away from the batter, Shahzad makes a leave.
This one tails back in a little as it is a touch full. It is on middle, Shahzad defends it again.
Back of a length on off, Shahzad defends it off the back foot.
We are back for the chase. The Afghanistan openers Mohammad Shehzad and Hazratullah Zazai make their way out to the middle. Mohammad Amir to open the bowling. Here we go...
